messages:
jonathan: :rotating_light: opening war-room — seeing a sudden 5xx spike across multiple hosted endpoints starting 2026-03-18T08:10:02Z. Customers reporting streaming timeouts and partial responses.

maria: on it, pulling autoscaler and circuit logs. what region?

jonathan: ap-northeast-1 and eu-west-1 primarily. p95 latency up, p50 steady. earliest traces show increased queueing before 5xx.

olivia: I just checked deploys — we rolled out autoscaler policy change to reduce min_ready to 0.2 at 07:55 in canary, promoted at 08:05. linking config: `autoscaler.min_ready=0.2`

kai: @maria logs show a flurry of scale-downs followed by rapid scale-ups — many containers marked unready then immediately killed. circuit breaker tripped in route-proxy: `cb_open=true count=18 window=30s`

maria: snippet from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-18T08:09:58Z INFO route-proxy cb_open=true route=/hosted/generate id=xyz
2026-03-18T08:10:03Z ERROR serve timeout request_id=abc status=504 backend=pod-12
```

jonathan: customers in CS queue: 6 high priority tickets complaining streaming cutouts. @cs-bot can we surface customers and ETA?

cs-bot: tickets: #C-50321, #C-50322, #C-50323. Notified account owners, sending apology + mitigation steps.

olivia: rollback the autoscaler policy to previous at 08:18? thoughts.

kai: temporary mitigations: 1) increase circuit breaker threshold 2) hold scale-downs for 5m (disable aggressive downscale) 3) route traffic to backup pool (dedicated fallback)

maria: I'm going to patch route-proxy to bump `cb_failure_threshold` from 15->40 and revert autoscaler config. doing a hotfix canary now.

maria: hotfix canary applied at 08:22, monitoring.

jonathan: metrics showing p95 dropping from 900ms -> 220ms after canary. 5xx rate down by ~78%.

kai: leaving downscale hold at +10m and opening a rollback PR for autoscaler policy — PR: #4278

olivia: creating postmortem ticket and assigning action items: autocaling safety for autoscaler, better pre-promotion test, alert threshold tuned. tagging SLO owners.

cs-bot: sent customer updates: immediate mitigation applied, team investigating root cause, will follow up with timeline.

maria: will follow up with logs and correlation by EOD. next steps: reproduce locally with rapid scale-down/up to validate.

jonathan: thanks all. please add any action items to the postmortem. :thumbsup:
